title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（佐藤弘美研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Sato Hiromi)
educationalGoal:
Finding problems to solve regarding timber structure.
Obtaining new knowledge through information collection, evaluation and analysis.
advice:
[Previous term]
Acquisition of basic knowledge / Project setting / Project execution
1)Learn basic knowledge about each activity area.
2)Receive guidance on each project theme through a report at the general report seminar and complete the project proposal.
3)Conduct experiments, analysis and design according to your project proposal.
[Latter term]
Project Implementation / Summary of Project Outcomes
4)Perform experiments, analysis and design according to your project proposal.
5)The results so far will be announced at the interim presentation on structural engineering.
6)Summarize the results of the activities performed (experiment, analysis, design).
7)Summarize the results of the entire project and submit it as a project report.
8)The contents of the project report will be announced at the public presentation review committee of Project DesignⅢ.
requiredKnowledge: Students should review and fully understand architectural subjects.
